name: monthly_trend_comparable
purpose: Show the recent month-by-month movement for the like-for-like branches so the summary can lead with the most recent period.
intent: Summarize by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[month] and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[max_date] for the like-for-like branch set CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, CFH021, with [net revenue CURRENT], [net revenue PAST], [revenue Growth], [revenue growth %], [net qty CURRENT], [net qty PAST], [QTY Growth], [QTY GROWTH %], [net bills CURRENT], derived prior transactions as [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth], [bills growth], [bills growth %], [retail price current year], [retail price past year], [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR], [SPEND PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR], and [SPEND PER TRANSACTION GROWTH]. Apply branch filters to MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB[store_no], CAT_TRANSACTIONS[store_no], CAT_TABLE[store_no], and MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[store_no]. Return the latest 15 rows sorted by MIS_DEEP_DIVE2[max_date] DESC.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[month],
        'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[max_date],
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'MIS_BASE_FILE_MONTHLY_BRAND_TB'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'CAT_TRANSACTIONS'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'CAT_TABLE'[store_no]
        ),
        TREATAS(
            { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
            'MIS_DEEP_DIVE2'[store_no]
        ),
        "net revenue CURRENT", [net revenue CURRENT],
        "net revenue PAST", [net revenue PAST],
        "revenue Growth", [revenue Growth],
        "revenue growth %", [revenue growth %],
        "net qty CURRENT", [net qty CURRENT],
        "net qty PAST", [net qty PAST],
        "QTY Growth", [QTY Growth],
        "QTY GROWTH %", [QTY GROWTH %],
        "net bills CURRENT", [net bills CURRENT],
        "net bills PAST", [net bills CURRENT] - [bills growth],
        "bills growth", [bills growth],
        "bills growth %", [bills growth %],
        "retail price current year", [retail price current year],
        "retail price past year", [retail price past year],
        "RETAIL PRICE GROWTH", [RETAIL PRICE GROWTH],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION CURRENT YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION PAST YEAR],
        "QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH", [QUANTITY PER TRANSACTION GROWTH],

name: daily_transactions_recent_true_branch_counts
purpose: Add a current-year recent transactions view using the daily branch transaction table, without using it for year-on-year comparison.
intent: Summarize rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt by rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[TY_DATE] and rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[LOC_CODE] for LOC_CODE values CFH014, CFH017, CFH018, and CFH021 only, computing true branch transactions from rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[LOC_BILLS] by taking the value once per date and branch level rather than summing repeated rows under departments or sections. Exclude dates after the latest date that has values in rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[LOC_BILLS]. Return the latest 15 date-branch rows sorted by rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt[TY_DATE] DESC.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    FILTER(
        ADDCOLUMNS(
            SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
                'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE],
                'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE],
                TREATAS(
                    { "CFH014", "CFH017", "CFH018", "CFH021" },
                    'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_CODE]
                )
            ),
            "True Branch Transactions",
            CALCULATE( MAX( 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS] ) )
        ),
        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]
            <= CALCULATE(
                MAX( 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE] ),
                FILTER(
                    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
                        'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE]
                    ),
                    CALCULATE( MAX( 'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[LOC_BILLS] ) ) <> BLANK()
                )
            )
    ),
    'rep_dept_wise_perf_eval_rpt'[TY_DATE], DESC
)
